title: Thread Pool Pattern — Companion
description: Runnable Python thread-pool examples: submit/as_completed, executor.map, per-future error handling, and Goetz's sizing formula. Offline — simulated I/O tasks.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables en Python de thread pools: submit/as_completed, executor.map, manejo de errores por future y la fórmula de dimensionado de Goetz. Offline — tareas I/O simuladas.
